items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, and Jimmy Cobb’s playing drums.

ctx.x: Yeah. I say, wait a minute. Now this – I say, he got to be one of the greatest of all time, to have a cat in overalls faint. Just jump up and fall, “Oh Jimmy, I can’t stand it.” I said, wait a minute. So I told him after the show. I said, “Jimmy, you got to be one of the greatest blues artists of all time.” He said, “I’ve been trying to tell you that.” So I started noticing with these ballads, that if the spirit come, you move men, who really don’t want to hear you play no ballad. Because I finally just got cold…
This brings up another question to mind. What do you think of women as musicians, as instrumentalists, not necessarily singers, because there’s a lot of women singing?
